topic: How to turn your teen's screen time into skill-building time
caption:
Your teen is already spending 7+ hours a day on screens. What if 30 minutes of that built a real skill and real money?

Pick one thing they love doing online and help them find one small gig this week. Editing videos, designing graphics, even helping a neighbor set up their phone.

One small win now builds the confidence that changes everything later. 💡

See how it works → hustleup.us
